sourceMode: Bundled public source snapshots; no new network fetch

sourceSnapshots.name: Country panel: IMF spending and WHO HALE

predictor.name: General government expenditure (% GDP)
predictor.definition: IMF Fiscal Monitor: central, state, local government and social security combined.

outcomes.name: Healthy life expectancy (HALE)
outcomes.definition: WHO expected healthy years at birth, both sexes. HALE is a population expectation, not median individual healthspan.

outcomes.name: Real after-tax median income
outcomes.definition: Survey-based median disposable income after direct taxes and cash transfers, adjusted for prices and purchasing power. One OECD or Eurostat series per country; no spending-derived income or PIP fallback.

methodology.intervalDescription: 95% percentile bootstrap interval for the equally weighted mean of country estimates; whole countries are resampled. It does not include source measurement error or identify a causal policy effect.
notes: Each country is compared with itself over 2000–2023 using retained OBG runCountryAnalysis and optimizer algorithms. No interpolation or extrapolation is added.

Higher-spending years are above that country's own mean spending share. Outcome difference compares the following 1–4 years after higher versus lower spending. Health differences are in years; income differences are percentages of each country's own baseline, not pooled dollars across incompatible price bases.

Exploratory annual summaries require at least eight aligned pairs, variation in both series and at least 10% of pairs in each exposure group. The generic optimizer's 30-pair quality check and its warnings remain in the country diagnostics; these summaries are not evidence-qualified policy recommendations.

Country trends and time-varying confounding can explain these associations. The report compares observed outcomes; it does not solve a joint national budget or convert total healthy years into median healthspan.
Income source metadata specifies inflation and PPP conversion bases. Annual PPP factors and different OECD/Eurostat price bases limit comparisons across countries and across time.

sensitivity.note: Start-year sensitivity re-runs the same floor benchmark with different left-window cutoffs; a separate COVID exclusion check drops 2020-2021 source years.

alignment.description: Predictor is measured at year t; outcome summaries are medians over years t+onset through t+duration.

healthyLifeYearsMetric.note: Growth is derived as annualized percent change in HALE.
